name: Waze police & hazards
description: Police, hazard and road reports from Waze, read from a self-hosted harvester, with a police heatmap built from sightings it has seen.
author: PhotoScout

permissions.detail: The harvester API key, sent only to the harvester at one of the hosts above
Police sightings for the heatmap, kept for seven days in the plugin's own database
Polls the Areas set up in the app on a schedule, in the background, to record police sightings for the heatmap. Runs only while Monitor my areas is on

settings.label: Harvester address
settings.help: Where the harvester answers, without a path: http://127.0.0.1:8098 (standalone), http://127.0.0.1:18199 (tunnel) or http://waze-reports:8088 (Compose service). The host and port must be one listed under this plugin's network permissions; the plugin sends its key to no other address.

settings.label: Harvester API key
settings.help: The harvester's SERVICE_API_KEY, sent as X-API-Key to that address only. Stored as a secret: the settings page shows only whether one is set.

settings.label: Monitor my areas on a schedule
settings.help: Off by default. When on, the plugin scans each area you have set up in the app (Settings → Map → Areas) on the interval below, in the background, and records police reports for the heatmap, so it keeps filling with no map open. Needs the harvester above to be running.

settings.label: Poll every (minutes)
settings.help: How often your Areas are scanned, from 1 to 1440 minutes. It applies only while the checkbox above is on. The schedule is set the first time monitoring is on, so after changing this, disable and enable the plugin (or restart the server) for the new interval to apply.
